description: Place one or more comments on an uploaded file in layernote, or on a Figma project’s frame, each as a pin at a spot on the picture (in percent, 0,0 top left), on a PDF page or at a moment in a video. A frame takes no page or moment. They appear at once for everyone on the project, clients on a share link included, under the name of the person who created the token and marked "via Claude". Look at the file with get_file first to place the pins well. Put every comment for one file in one call: the team then gets one notification, not one per pin. Only place comments when the user asks for it.

comments.description: The comments, up to 50 for one file

at.description: A video: the moment, in seconds (required on a video)

duration.description: A video: how long the comment runs from at, in seconds

xPercent.description: The pin, from the left edge, in percent of the width

yPercent.description: The pin, from the top edge, in percent of the height

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

name: add_comments
title: Place comments on a file
